ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
After losing my 10-year-old Weber Spirit 310 in Hurricane Helene, I decided to replace it with the Weber E325. My previous Weber performed exceptionally well, so I felt the premium price was justified based on my past experience.

Overall, I’m pleased with the size and build quality of the E325. However, one downside is that it doesn’t reach the same high temperatures as my old Spirit 310. While my previous grill could max out the temperature gauge, the E325 seems to top out around 450°F. Despite this, it still delivers solid performance, and I trust Weber’s durability and reliability.
Results.Title: Great size but it could get hotter

Results.ReviewText:
As expected, the grill lights easily and heats up quickly. 

The real clincher for me was the even heat dispersion. 

We had 20mph winds tonight, and I was cooking 3 thick steaks and 8 chicken breasts on high heat (500 degrees). 

Even with all the wind gusts, everything cooked evenly and turned out great. There were no hot spots. 

Fantastic grill.
Results.Title: No hot spots . . . even in gusty winds

Results.ReviewText: Receiving this grill makes it perfect for our backyard. I have a small backyard and since the grill so compact and convenience, it fit perfect in one of the corner, doesn’t take up much space because the side rail is foldable but very sturdy. Assembly was not difficult at all just a little bit heavy. It used propane gas which i really love because it make the food taste much better. When turn on it giving evenly heat throughout the grill. Would definitely recommend for family and friends!! Love love!
Results.Title: Sturdy and compacted

Results.ReviewText: Finally got my beautiful Weber grill. This big box weighs 110 pounds, seems easy to assemble within 1 hour, and looks clean, slick and smooth, nice internal thermometer for temperature control
